monetization.reason: No approved affiliate program or tracking ID is configured. The active conversion improvement is a product-neutral flower-form comparison for a purchase-ready reader: it reconciles the retail term, regulated category, package identity, net weight, lot evidence, condition, substitution, receipt, storage fit, and checkout total. The Białobrzeskie profile adds a seed-and-trial source check without a seller, shopping link, cultivar recommendation, price, rating, availability claim, or affiliate conclusion.

image_qa.note: All three new pages and the canonical-host change use original text, tables, checklists, and existing interface assets. The Białobrzeskie profile explicitly withholds a cultivar photograph because no exact licensed image was verified. No flower, mold, package, laboratory, seed, crop, product, affiliate, generated, stock, or third-party image was added or changed, so no ambiguous condition image, false cultivar identification, exact-product mismatch, or new licensing issue was introduced.

search_console.decision: The October 19–November 15 report is five days old and valid: 830 impressions, three clicks, 0.361% CTR, and average position 20.688. The report exposes one HTTP article URL and old sitemap errors; a direct live check on November 23 confirmed that the bare HTTP host still serves HTML instead of redirecting. That changed today's Data-led action from another topic page to a site-wide canonical-host bootstrap and audit contract. The 36-impression Blue Dream row and 10-impression Arkansas page were already materially reinforced November 17 and November 12. The two-impression 510/disposable and trimming-scissors queries, two-impression Delaware page, and one-impression chronic-pain row were deliberately ignored as too small to steer editorial topics.

authority.action: Published two citation-ready assets: a water-activity and moisture guide with a four-measurement map, lot-to-report chain, jurisdiction example, home-reading boundary, condition stop screen, and primary sources; and a Białobrzeskie research field note that compares Cornell, NC State, and UC Davis trial questions while preserving cultivar, seed-lot, site-year, sample, and finished-product boundaries. Reciprocal links strengthen the contaminant, flower-freshness, storage, humidity-tool, flower-form, label, grinder, cultivar-terminology, seed-record, and CBD/hemp clusters. The editorial policy records the scientific, terminology, and site-year boundaries. No outreach opportunity was logged and no outreach was sent; the on-site assets and reciprocal clusters were the higher-value authority action.
